title: PAINT & TRIM- EXTERIOR ORNAMENTATION
summary: Overview of where the exterior trim and badges go on a 1970 Corvette: front (crossed-flags nose) and rear emblems, Stingray name plate on the front fender, fender louver trim (side vent grilles), rocker molding and upper molding along the rocker panel, rear CORVETTE name plate, back-up lamp bezels, and option items: LT1 hood decal and paint stripe, LS5 hood molding and '454' numbers, LS7 hood decal, C07 auxiliary hardtop, and UA6 alarm switch at the rear. No part numbers or fasteners on this sheet.
notes: All items shown are regular production unless otherwise noted.
notes_internal: Locator diagram only: labels without part numbers or callouts; listed in tables.
No revisions entered in the revision block.
Top-right 'Emblem' label partly wiped by a binder hole.
